title: Atrium: sensual sculpture shortlist
scope: 55 sculpture and relief candidates for curatorial selection, not a batch of 55 acquired or cleared 3D models.
selection: Adult intimacy, non-graphic nudity, bathing, drapery and sensuous sculptural form. Core and Supporting are curatorial judgments, not museum classifications.
public_domain_priority: Most designs predate 1931. CC0/public-domain image claims are recorded only where checked. Two later Maillol works are explicit rights-review reserves.
deduplication: Object URLs, model IDs, titles and makers checked; named near-duplicates reviewed. A different cast of an already represented composition was not counted merely to increase the total. Final accession-level matching remains part of ingest.
verification_limits: Object/source research and model-license metadata verified; source thumbnails for the five open-license leads visually inspected. No mesh acquisition, geometric QA or orientation review completed. Publication-metadata.json contains detailed object and scan attribution checks.
